Analytics FAQs
What analytics can I access with a Klaviyo Marketing plan?

Whether you’re using Klaviyo Email, SMS, Mobile Push or Reviews, Klaviyo Marketing offers best-in-class reporting so you can measure marketing performance and growth. Easily track subscriber trends, marketing engagement, deliverability and industry benchmarks through clear dashboards and customisable reports.
What analytics can I access with a Klaviyo Marketing Analytics plan?
Marketers need more than clicks and opens, so Klaviyo Marketing Analytics makes it easy to predict, personalise and automate outreach based on customer behaviour and business trends.
What are my benchmarks based on?

Klaviyo provides detailed benchmarks so you can track your performance and opportunities to improve, compared with your personalised peer group. Benchmarks are based on anonymised data from businesses in your industry of a similar size, scope and market position.
How can I use AI in Klaviyo Analytics?

Klaviyo AI helps you unlock powerful insights and analytics, which act as fuel for automatic 1:1 marketing personalisation. Klaviyo Analytics features use AI to automate A/B testing, optimise audiences, deliver campaigns at personalised send times, summarise review sentiments, and more.
How is Klaviyo Analytics different from other analytics solutions?
Klaviyo Analytics connects your entire B2C CRM, so you can quickly and easily understand performance, identify opportunities, and optimise experiences across the full customer journey.
Can I customize Klaviyo Analytics?
Yes! Klaviyo Analytics gives you the flexibility to easily filter, customise and export reports and dashboards.
